sloka: एवम् उक्तो अंशुमान् सम्यक् सगरेण महात्मना ।धनुर् आदाय खड्गम् च जगाम लघुविक्रमः ॥१-४१-५॥
transliteration: evam ukto aṁśumān samyak sagareṇa mahātmanā ।dhanur ādāya khaḍgam ca jagāma laghuvikramaḥ ॥1-41-5॥

translations.english: "Having been throughly instructed by the highsouled Sagara in this way, Anshuman left with rapid strides carrying a scimitar and a bow.
